thread:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — we want to push the March launch tomorrow. Need the canonical changelog link, docs shortlink, exact canary start, webinar CTA + reg link, and lead routing plan. Can engineering confirm timings and auto-fallback?
Evan (Engineering): Changelog is merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/489 — covers model pinning, batching defaults, and SDK note.
Evan (Engineering): Rollout schedule: canary start 09:00 PT -> observe 90m -> ramp 40% at 10:30 PT -> full by 14:00 PT. Auto-fallback to previous stable model on error spike.
Maya (Marketing): Please lock canary start. We need the start for countdown and to sync the press release time.
Evan (Engineering): Locked. Feature flag rf_march_launch=true at 09:00 PT. Health gate: p95 latency < 450ms and error_rate < 0.5% over rolling 5m, else rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled by Evan for 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Monitors: latency_p95, error_rate, kvcache_hit_ratio.
Sofia (Docs): Docs live at https://docs.redwood.com/releases/mar-24 — shortlink for marketing: https://rwd.io/mar24-launch. Added anchors: #model-pinning #batching-best-practices.
Noah (Product): Suggested announcement bullets: 1) Model pinning for predictable behavior; 2) Lower cost via smarter batching; 3) Safer rollouts with canary + auto-fallback. Include a short benchmark phrase ("up to 30% cost reduction at similar p95") linking to the blog. OK for marketing to use?
Maya (Marketing): Yes. We'll craft the headline and a one-line benchmark. Webinar scheduled 10:30 PT — 30m demo + 20m Q&A. Registration: https://events.redwood.com/mar24-launch
Maya (Marketing): Lead routing ask: route webinar signups and launch page leads to SDR queue 'launch-march' and tag by region. Can ops set this up?
ops-oncall: Yes — will create HubSpot rule: source=mar24_launch -> queue=launch-march; region tag from form field or IP. Will test and promote before 08:30 PT tomorrow.
Evan (Engineering): Heads-up: embeddings endpoint will have a 45s config tweak at 11:00 PT — no expected downtime but avoid embedding-heavy demo calls at that minute.
Maya (Marketing): Noted — we'll avoid embeddings during that window.
Sofia (Docs): Added changelog note in docs: "See PR #489 for full CHANGELOG — API and SDK changes, plus recommended rollout config."
Noah (Product): Launch checklist: docs link ✅, changelog ✅, canary + rollback ✅, webinar link + deck? Marketing to share deck by 07:00 PT tomorrow. Ops routing ✅ once promoted.
ops-oncall: Routing rule created and tested in staging. Will promote at 08:15 PT and post confirmation here. Monitoring dashboard shared to #launch-ops.
Maya (Marketing): Timing for public announce? Plan is to start canary at 09:00 PT, public post at 10:15 PT (right before webinar). Confirm?
Evan (Engineering): Fine. Keep #release-monitor open. If rollback triggers, hold public post.
Maya (Marketing): Will do. Posting pre-announce notes to GTM at 08:45 PT. :rocket:
Noah (Product): Please loop support for first 48h inbound.
Sofia (Docs): Short FAQ snippet for marketing: "How to pin a model — see Model pinning section with CLI and SDK examples."
Evan (Engineering): Also increased autoscaler buffer for first 2 hours to avoid noisy upscales during ramp.
ops-oncall: Promoted routing at 08:17 PT; will keep an eye on lead spikes and post updates.
